Hypothetical scope/cleanup cost are explicit additions, not permission to interrupt.

Changed cost and fragmented groups, resources through signal/release/re-admission, visibility extension/expiry/redelivery ownership/resource/outcomes, expected and observed/supplied/unexecuted results, fair receive versus useful start/finish, named-window tenant/resource held-unit-time including signaled operations, deadlines, allocation and eventual progress, unavailable measurements labeled.

A returned record is required rather than advice to define it later; proposed/unexecuted checks cannot establish observed behavior. N/A is allowed only for an absent branch; unknown facts are unresolved, each row retains supplied/executed/proposed/unresolved status, never invent evidence.
